page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Page number top left, running head top centre, catchword bottom right.

main_text.p: collo suspensas, peccata hominum æque purgare, ut Christi sanguis purgat: easdem affirmat fulgura depellere, parturientibus opem ferre, & homines ex incendio ac naufragio seruare. Quid sceleratius dici aut cogitari potest? Atqui maiorum hæ traditiones appellantur, huic Papæ à superioribus per manus traditæ. Nam in lib. Ceremon. Pontific. 1. sect. 7. scriptum ita est,

p.i: Balsamus & cera munda, cum Chrismatis unda Conficiunt agnum: quod munus do tibi magnum Fonte velut natum per mystica sanctificatum, Fulgura desursum depellit, omne malignum Peccatum frangit, ut CHRISTI SANGVIS & angit.
Prægnans seruatur, simul & partus liberatur. Dona refert dignis, virtutes destruet ignis. Portatus munde de fluctibus eripit unda.

main_text.p: Ex eodē genere illud est carmē impiū ac plane ne-farium quod nō multis ante annis Biturigę in summo Episcopali templo in tabula lapidea incisum, & ad caput trunci siue tigilli pauperum affixum e-rat: sed Francisci Duareni admonitu, qui tum in illa Academia ius ciuile profitebatur exemptum ac disturbatum est.

p.i: Hic des deuote cælestibus associo te,[?] Mentes ægrotæ per munera sunt ibi lotæ. Ergo venite gentes à sorde remotæ. Qui datis, estote certi de diuite dote. Te precor, accelera, spargas hic dum potes æra: Et sic reuera secure calica spera.
O si tu scires quantum data profit ibi res, Tu iuxta vires donares quod dare quires.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "associo" (first line of the verse stanza, read as "affocio" in the scan, marked [?]); "calica spera" (last verse line, the word split is unclear); "e-rat" printed with a line-end hyphen; "eodē", "carmē" and "Biturigę" follow the printed abbreviations. Long s and s are normalised to s, u/v to u or v by the rules; the verse lines are copied as printed. Catchword "Te" appears only in the bottom margin.
